name: Executed commercial or incentive agreement

patterns_used: Use a controlled two-page form with explicit lifecycle, approvals, implementation, distribution, optional attachments, and retention metadata.
foundation_lineage.transformation_boundary: Reuse only explicit lifecycle, approval, distribution, attachment, and retention controls; draft all terms, exhibits, parties, facts, execution evidence, and formatting from the authorized new world.

producer: Legal, commercial, and governmental or counterparty representatives
purpose: Record enforceable terms, definitions, conditions, remedies, schedules, and execution evidence.
medium: Native or assembled executed PDF with exhibits

authority.governing_scope: Controls the fictional parties' enforceable terms within the agreement scope.
authority.non_governing_scope: Does not control matters outside its scope or make drafts, summaries, and working notes authoritative.

authorized_inputs: Approved fictional-world parties, terms, dates, and execution authority
Approved schedules, exhibits, and referenced calculations
excluded_inputs: Unapproved terms or fabricated execution authority
source_boundary.conflict_resolution: The executed agreement and incorporated schedules govern; drafts and summaries remain explicitly non-governing.

footprint.target: 15-40 pages including schedules and signature pages
natural_depth: Execution blocks supported by the approved fictional world
footprint.source_owned_rationale: The footprint comes from defined terms, negotiated obligations, boilerplate, schedules, exhibits, and execution mechanics required by the agreement.

sequence: Terms and schedules drafted from approved world facts
Authorized fictional parties review final form
Execution evidence applied within approved authority
Executed copy assembled, distributed, and retained

features: Standard clauses not needed for the assignment
Blank notice fields only where normal
Restrained assembly or scan variation when the execution lifecycle supports it

prohibited: Casual internal annotations on the authoritative original
Missing referenced exhibit that carries a governing fact

proof_gates.procedure: Cross-check defined terms, governing clauses, dates, signatures, schedules, and exhibits.
Render every page and verify page, signature, schedule, and exhibit continuity.
Inspect PDF properties, embedded files, annotations, signatures, layers, and producer metadata.
Confirm governing calculations are validated in separately cited schedules.
proof_gates.not_applicable_rationale: The PDF template does not execute material formulas; cited schedules own computation.

proof_gates.procedure: Trace parties, terms, dates, authority, and execution evidence to approved world sources.
Scan visible text, metadata, annotations, attachments, and hidden layers for residue.
Verify executed terms are distinguishable from drafts, summaries, and contextual material.
Map clauses, schedules, exhibits, and boilerplate to a plausible legal purpose.
